_comment: Exceptions to plain Title Case, for names in FamCart's house style
Not listed here because they are rules rather than words:
- a token starting with a digit is left verbatim, which covers 2L, 500g,
- a single letter is left verbatim ('Marimea M' is a size code)
- a hyphenated token is title-cased on both sides (Coca-Cola), unless the
whole token is a brand-alias key, in which case the canonical spelling wins
`lower` are Romanian function words, lowercased unless they lead the name --
the curated catalog reads 'Crema de Alune', not 'Crema De Alune'.
